description: This file defines an Android Activity named DialogActivity, which is used as a dialog-style activity with no title bar. It overrides onCreate to set up the UI and contains a method to finish the activity in response to a button click.

classes.name: DialogActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a dialog-style UI without a title bar.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the window to no title, and inflates the dialog layout.

methods.name: finishDialog
methods.description: Handles the button click to finish and close the activity.
